chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his late twenties, short black hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow puffer jacket over a grey hoodie, dark jeans
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman in her early twenties, wearing a black djellaba with a loose black headscarf, tired teary eyes
chars.MOM: a warm Moroccan mother in her fifties, wearing a bright turquoise house kaftan and a white headscarf
chars.BROTHERS: two Moroccan young men in their twenties, one in a red tracksuit, one in a white t-shirt and green cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cold rainy winter night on a dark street in Casablanca under a streetlight. NARRATOR holds his phone to his ear, worried, while GIRL stands beside him hugging herself and crying. Both in the center of the frame, full body, wet pavement reflections.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cozy Moroccan living room at night with traditional sedari sofas and a teapot, MOM sits holding a phone to her ear, kind surprised smile, one hand raised as if saying no problem.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a Moroccan apartment at night: MOM opens the door warmly and welcomes the shy GIRL inside, putting a hand on her shoulder, NARRATOR behind them carrying a wet umbrella.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon at night with long sedari sofas and thick blankets: MOM lies on one sofa and GIRL lies on another, MOM tucks a blanket around GIRL kindly, soft lamp light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a Moroccan kitchen, breakfast of msemen and mint tea on a small table. NARRATOR leans in and whispers worriedly to MOM, both glancing toward the salon door.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Bright Moroccan kitchen by day: GIRL, now relaxed and smiling, cooks a tagine next to MOM, both laughing together like family, a wall calendar visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room by day: BROTHERS sit on the sofa grinning and nudging NARRATOR with teasing looks, NARRATOR embarrassed rubbing his neck.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: MOM sits upright with a serious stern face, arms crossed, looking straight at NARRATOR who sits across from her nervously.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: MOM points her finger at NARRATOR with a half-angry half-teasing expression, NARRATOR wide-eyed and shocked, hands up, comic moment.
